messages.subject: subsetting question
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Having found (post-hoc) an unfortunate typo in our experimental stimulus, I'm now trying to exclude from a data frame all rows for the relevant test items, based on factor levels in the Target column.
I've found a way of selecting all the items to be removed, but not a way of excluding them.  Could anybody tell me how to amend command below to subset elements NOT matching the criterion below, please?

> dat2 <- subset(dat, dat$Target %in% c("freezer magnet", "freezer magent", "magnet freezer", "magent freezer", "kitchen utensil", "kitchen ustensil", "utensil kitchen", "ustensil kitchen"), drop = TRUE)

There's surely a neater way of doing the above using grep, but I haven't managed to work it out.

Many thanks in advance.

Cecile

messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] subsetting question
messages.body_plain:
If you subset with negative numbers, you get rid of stuff:

x <- data.frame(letters, 1:26, rnorm(26))
x.new <http://x.new> <- x[-(x$letters %in% c("a", "g", "m")),] # or
x.new <http://x.new> <- x[!(grepl("[agm]", x$letters)),] # or

Cheers,
STG
--
Stefan Th. Gries
